digest.component_or_area: rebar store sync / reconverge union merge
propositions: Compaction writes SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired files without atomic rollback, leaving untracked artifacts in the working tree when the detached sweep is interrupted.
Union merge in reconverge runs git merge origin/tickets, which aborts with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge' when origin has pushed those same regenerable paths.
Push recovery cannot clear untracked files because git reset --hard is tracked-only and git stash without -u omits untracked files, causing permanent wedge and stranding local commits off origin.

The fix detects the untracked-overwrite abort signature, relocates only the named untracked paths into a quarantine directory outside the worktree, and retries the merge once, keeping both parents and preventing orphaned commits.

Tracked .archived files deleted by interrupted compaction remain as dirty-state deletions indefinitely because gitignore never un-tracks already-tracked files, causing LLM plan-review and completion-verify gates to fail on store-read checks.
